logline: 숲에 버려진 오누이가 조약돌로 길을 찾고, 두 번째에는 빵조각을 뿌린다.
protagonist: 낡은 외투를 걸친 열 살 남짓 소년
setting: 중세 독일의 가난한 오두막과 깊은 숲
anchor: a boy of about ten in a worn coat, a girl slightly younger beside him
palette: dark green, moonlit silver, crust brown, pale white, warm amber

hansel.label: 오빠
hansel.desc: a boy of about ten, straw-blond hair, worn brown coat with deep pockets, scuffed boots

gretel.label: 여동생
gretel.desc: a girl of about eight, straw-blond hair under a kerchief, patched grey dress and apron

witch_old.label: 노파
witch_old.desc: a stooped old woman in dark shawls, thin hands, small round spectacles

cottage.label: 오두막
cottage.desc: a poor timber cottage at the forest edge, low door, one shuttered window

forest.label: 깊은 숲
forest.desc: towering dark trunks, ferns underfoot, little light reaching the ground

candy_house.label: 과자 집
candy_house.desc: a cottage of iced cake with sugar window panes and biscuit tiles, in a clearing
